close_reason: Fixed: added Debug to CheckMode derive.
description:
pkix-path/src/lib.rs:2190–2196

CheckMode is declared as:

    #[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    enum CheckMode { Excluded, Permitted }

It is missing Debug.  Any type that can appear in a match arm or be held in a struct that derives Debug should itself derive Debug.  Without it, if someone wraps CheckMode in a struct or Result for debugging purposes they get a compiler error rather than an automatic impl.

By Rust convention, all concrete types that are Clone + PartialEq should also be Debug unless there is a specific reason to suppress it (e.g., containing a non-Debug third-party type).  There is no such reason here.

Fix: add Debug to the derive list.
title: CheckMode missing Debug impl
